TRIAL_RECORD.title: Trial Record
TRIAL_RECORD.description: Records which heirs you have challenged this run.
TRIAL_RECORD.flavor: A single thread of fate, woven in.
ROMANCE_RESONANCE.title: Romance Resonance
ROMANCE_RESONANCE.description: At the start of each combat, gain [blue]1[/blue] additional Energy. Whenever you play a Skill card, gain [blue]1[/blue] [blue]Gold Thread[/blue].
GOLDEN_WEB.title: Golden Web
GOLDEN_WEB.description: Whenever you gain Energy, draw [blue]1[/blue] card. Your hand size is reduced by [blue]1[/blue].
GOLDEN_WEB.flavor: The web of fate, thread by thread.
GOLDEN_COCOON.title: Golden Cocoon
GOLDEN_COCOON.description: At the start of each combat, gain [blue]2[/blue] Strength and [blue]3[/blue] Block. But you lose [blue]3[/blue] HP at the end of each of your turns.
GOLDEN_COCOON.flavor: Peering at fate from within the cocoon.
WEAVER_GIFT.title: Weaver's Gift
FATE_SPINDLE.title: Fate Spindle
FATE_SPINDLE.description: Whenever you play a card, [blue]25%[/blue] chance your next card costs [blue]0[/blue].
GOLDEN_ROSE_FINGER.title: Golden Rose Finger
GOLDEN_ROSE_FINGER.description: Upgraded Attack cards deal [blue]5[/blue] additional damage. Upgraded Skill cards grant [blue]3[/blue] additional Block. Upon pickup, upgrade a card in your deck.
GOLDEN_ROSE_FINGER.flavor: A golden rose crowns the hero.
